patch_description: This version combines multi-start greedy construction, lexicographic KVPR-profile improvement, direct relocations, swaps, two-for-one exchanges, and three-GPU evacuation chains. It precomputes model sizes and request-pressure weights, uses index-based placements for lower overhead, and includes a memory-first fallback construction when pressure-oriented starts cannot find a feasible assignment. Every accepted local-search action strictly improves the sorted KVPR profile, therefore the maximum KVPR never increases.
